WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT e."aCL IgG" AS val
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE e."Examination Date" > p."First Date"
      AND e."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL
      AND p."First Date" IS NOT NULL
      AND e."aCL IgG" IS NOT NULL
),
cnts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM filtered
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT val,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY val) AS rn
    FROM filtered, cnts
),
stats AS (
    SELECT (cnt+1)*0.25 AS r1,
           (cnt+1)*0.75 AS r3
    FROM cnts
),
q1 AS (
    SELECT AVG(val) AS q1
    FROM ordered
    WHERE rn BETWEEN (SELECT floor(r1) FROM stats) AND (SELECT ceil(r1) FROM stats)
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT AVG(val) AS q3
    FROM ordered
    WHERE rn BETWEEN (SELECT floor(r3) FROM stats) AND (SELECT ceil(r3) FROM stats)
)

FROM filtered f, q1, q3
WHERE f.val >= q1.q1 - 1.5*(q3.q3 - q1.q1)

}

               WHEN L."T-BIL" >= 2.0 OR L."T-BIL" IS NULL THEN 'T-BIL'
               WHEN L."T-CHO" >= 250 OR L."T-CHO" IS NULL THEN 'T-CHO'
               WHEN L."TG" >= 200 OR L."TG" IS NULL THEN 'TG'
               WHEN L."CPK" >= 250 OR L."CPK" IS NULL THEN 'CPK'
               WHEN L."GLU" >= 180 OR L."GLU" IS NULL THEN 'GLU'
               WHEN L."WBC" < 3.5 OR L."WBC" > 9.0 OR L."WBC" IS NULL THEN 'WBC'
               WHEN L."RBC" < 3.5 OR L."RBC" > 6.0 OR L."RBC" IS NULL THEN 'RBC'

WITH paired AS (
    SELECT
        e.ID,
        e."aCL IgG" AS x,
        l.GPT AS y
    FROM "Examination" e
    JOIN "Laboratory" l
        ON e.ID = l.ID
        AND e."Examination Date" = l.Date
    WHERE e."aCL IgG" IS NOT NULL
      AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(x * y) - SUM(x) * SUM(y)) /
    SQRT(
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(x * x) - SUM(x) * SUM(x)) *
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(y * y) - SUM(y) * SUM(y))
    ) AS correlation
FROM paired
GROUP BY ID;
